profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Curaleaf
profile.summary:
I am a full stack software engineer with a passion for building useful and scalable applications to improve the quality of life. Stemming from my youthful curiosity for how things work, enthusiasm for improvement, and desire to help, my interest in technology has led me to the realization that writing code to solve problems and create applications allows me to be creative while making a perceivable difference for its users. 

Leveraging technologies such as Express, React, Node.js, NGINX, as well as NoSQL and SQL databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, I seek to join an innovative and fast-paced team that addresses ever changing and complex challenges that solves real world problems.

positions.title: Technical Mentor
positions.description:
Delivered learning materials/lectures on:
- Asynchronous Programming
- RESTful API Design
- Client-Side Frameworks/Libraries
- Server-Side Technologies
- Database Management Systems

Guided quality software engineers by:
- Completing code reviews with positive feedback/plans for improvement
- Tailoring lectures with various forms of delivery
- Easing students into developing a debugging + autonomous mindset
- Leading 1 on 1 sessions to better understand gaps in technical knowledge and opportunities for growth
- Contributing to staff meetings by discussing goals, blockers, and solutions to improve curriculum and student experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineering Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for providing educational, technical, and emotional support for software engineering immersive students.
